title: Triage signal-sorting workshop — backlog noise reduction
body:
Summary:
This is a working record of the November 6 triage workshop. Goal: reduce backlog noise, surface high-leverage console/rollouts work for the next two sprints, and create a lightweight signal-ranking rubric we can apply consistently. Attendees: Maya (owner), Ethan (PM), Priya (UX), Jonas (SWE), 6 ICs from support/solutions.

Top-level decisions (quick):
- Adopt 5-point signal rubric (User impact, Regression risk, Effort, Observability benefit, Dependency risk). Score 0-4 each, sum -> priority band (0-8 low, 9-14 medium, 15-20 high).
- Hold low-score items in "parking" bucket for 6 weeks; auto-review at next workshop.
- Reserve 30% sprint capacity as "ops buffer" to reduce hotfix-promoted churn.

Signals we used (notes):
- User impact: customer-reported tickets, feature usage telemetry, sales asks (weight x2 for enterprise SLA customers).
- Regression risk: touches rollout/rollbacks, feature flags, migration surface.
- Effort: quick dev estimate (T-shirt) converted to points (0-4).
- Observability: adds dashboards/traces that pay back ops time (prefer higher).
- Dependency: external infra/hard blockers (downgrade score).

Example scoring (applied to 6 candidate tickets):
1) JIRA-5289 "per-route latency view" -> User 3, Reg 2, Effort 2, Obs 4, Dep 1 = 12 (medium) -> keep for sprint A (high ops ROI).
2) JIRA-5290 "intake form: missing owner" -> User 1, Reg 1, Effort 1, Obs 0, Dep 0 = 3 (low) -> park.
3) JIRA-5335 "rollout canary failure mode docs" -> User 2, Reg 3, Effort 1, Obs 3, Dep 0 = 9 (medium) -> tie-breaker: schedule for sprint B.
4) JIRA-5402 "console: collapsed route list performance" -> User 4, Reg 2, Effort 3, Obs 2, Dep 1 = 12 (medium) -> candidate for sprint A 
5) JIRA-5431 "enable auto-fallback policy toggles" -> User 3, Reg 4, Effort 4, Obs 2, Dep 2 = 15 (high) -> gated highest priority (needs arch sync).
6) JIRA-5460 "small UX polish: empty state copy" -> User 1, Reg 0, Effort 0, Obs 0, Dep 0 = 1 (low) -> park or batch in later polishing pass.

Proposed cutlist for Sprint A (Nov 17 start) based on scoring + capacity:
- Top 30% capacity: JIRA-5431 (auto-fallback policy) -> blockers: arch review (owner: Jonas).
- Next: JIRA-5289 (per-route latency view) -> add minimal MVP: table + link to trace (owner: Ethan).
- Ops buffer (~30%): live-triage window for urgent customer escalations + on-call handover runbook updates.
- Defer: JIRA-5290, JIRA-5460 (park).

Wireframe/walkthrough notes (UX):
- Per-route latency: show 99/95/50, toggle timeframe, quick link to trace; wireframe v2 attached (see Slack #console-wireframes).
- Collapsed route list perf: consider virtualized list + progressive render (Priya to prototype).

Open questions / unresolved items:
- How strict should enterprise weight be? (suggest: multiply user-impact by 1.5 for accounts > $100k ARR) -> action: Maya to propose policy by Nov 12.
- Do we triage infra-owned tickets in this forum or route to infra triage? Short term: surface high-user-impact infra tickets here but auto-assign to infra.

Next steps / owners: 
- Maya: publish trimmed backlog list + update sprint A plan (due 2025-11-11).
- Jonas: schedule arch sync for JIRA-5431 (due 2025-11-13).
- Priya: deliver per-route latency prototype + figma link (due 2025-11-14).
- Ethan: update JIRA-5289 acceptance criteria w/ minimal MVP (due 2025-11-12).

Notes to self / rough heuristics:
- If score ties between items, prefer the one with higher Observability benefit (we value reducing ops toil).
- Keep recurring "parked" review on calendar (6-week cadence).

Attachments / references:
- Figma: figma.com/file/console/per-route-latency-v2 (sketch, not final).
- Slack thread: #console-wireframes (Nov 6).
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/742 (latency table POC).

Workshop retrospective (quick):
- What worked: simple numerical rubric, cross-functional tie-breaks, clear owners assigned.
- What didn’t: we spent too long debating low-impact polish; need timebox next time (30m).

Tags for search: backlog-trim, triage-workshop, per-route-latency, auto-fallback, sprint-cutlist

If anything missing or you disagree with assignments, flag in Slack thread or add comments under the linked JIRAs.
